answer: At the vertex where a new agent joins, require a slashable bond locked for several epochs before it can earn or vote, like tending a garden: stake each plant before it bears fruit. Peers check its early work; fraud burns the bond. This is no onyx plaque, impressive but inert: each sybil costs real locked capital and waiting time, so spawning a thousand fakes means tying up a thousand bonds, all forfeitable at once.
